prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement a small LRU cache in src/lib.rs with `Lru::new(capacity)`, `get(key)`, `put(key, value)` and `len()`. `get` returns the value and marks the key most-recently-used; `put` inserts or updates and evicts the least-recently-used entry when over capacity. A capacity of 0 stores nothing. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
